places: Mont Blanc (Monte Bianco) de Courmayeur (a secondary peak of Mont Blanc)

fields.climate: predominantly Mediterranean; alpine in far north; hot, dry in south
fields.terrain: mostly rugged and mountainous; some plains, coastal lowlands
fields.hazards: regional risks include landslides, mudflows, avalanches, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, flooding; land subsidence in Venice; volcanism: significant volcanic activity…
fields.resources: coal, antimony, mercury, zinc, potash, marble, barite, asbestos, pumice, fluorspar, feldspar, pyrite (sulfur), natural gas and crude oil reserves, fish, arable land
fields.farm: milk, wheat, grapes, tomatoes, maize, olives, apples, oranges, sugar beets, rice
fields.exports: packaged medicine, garments, cars, refined petroleum, vehicle parts/accessories
fields.industries: tourism, machinery, iron and steel, chemicals, food processing, textiles, motor vehicles, clothing, footwear, ceramics
fields.languages: Italian (official), German (parts of Trentino-Alto Adige region are predominantly German-speaking), French (small French-speaking minority in Valle d'Aosta region), Slovene (Slovene-speaking minority…
fields.religions: Christian 80.8% (overwhelmingly Roman Catholic with very small groups of Jehovah's Witnesses and Protestants), Muslim 4.9%, unaffiliated 13.4%, other 0.9%
fields.legal: civil law system; Constitutional Court reviews legislation under certain conditions
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal except in senatorial elections, where minimum age is 25
fields.military: 17 or 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; voluntary service is a minimum of 12 months with the option to extend in the Armed Forces or compete for positions in other…
